title: Interaction Corrupter
description: Minecraft mod that corrupts your Minecraft world everytime you interact with something.
body:
**This mod was made by only me, thank you for using it :)**

Interaction Corrupter is a Minecraft mod where player actions can corrupt the world over time.

Every interaction such as breaking blocks, placing blocks, opening containers, attacking entities, or using items has a chance to corrupt nearby subchunks. As corruption spreads, terrain can shift, break down, or become unstable, changing the environment in unpredictable ways.

Corruption is not limited to a single dimension. In rare cases, subchunks from other dimensions can leak into the world and replace areas with terrain, structures, or corrupted areas.

Each world develops corruption differently depending on player activity, leading to increasingly unstable and changing environments as the game progresses. **Make sure you have a decent PC if you want to use multiplayer!** The more players the more chaotic the mod becomes.
